appDescription: MILE is a Gyeongju travel story app providing spoken responses to questions about local places, history and culture.

function.name: ASK_STORY_QUESTION
function.description: Respond to a visitor's question about Gyeongju places, history, culture or regional stories using the app's content.

question.description: The visitor's complete question in their own words.

function.name: STOP_NEARBY_STORY
function.description: Stop the app's current spoken response and discard any pending question.
